_comment: Demonstration dataset. Loaded ONLY by the Go seeder when DEMO_MODE=true (backend/internal/infrastructure/demoseed). Never shipped to the frontend, never imported by application code. Any tenant seeded from this file shows a permanent 'demonstration data' banner. Impact 0-10, probability 0-1 (Score Engine bounds).

risks.title: Unpatched web framework on web-prod-01
risks.description: The public front end runs a framework release with known remote-code-execution CVEs. An exploit is publicly available.

risks.title: Backup restoration never tested
risks.description: Nightly snapshots complete, but no restoration drill has been run. Recovery time is unverified.

risks.title: Excessive database privileges for application account
risks.description: The portal's service account holds superuser rights on db-core-01; a portal compromise becomes a full data breach.

risks.title: Phishing exposure across the HR fleet
risks.description: HR endpoints handle payroll attachments daily; no simulated phishing campaign has been run this year.

risks.title: Legacy TLS ciphers accepted on the portal
risks.description: The load balancer still negotiates TLS 1.0/1.1 for a handful of legacy clients.

incidents.title: Suspicious outbound traffic from web-prod-01
incidents.description: Egress spike to an unfamiliar ASN observed overnight. Contained; forensics in progress.

incidents.title: Payroll phishing attempt reported by HR
incidents.description: An employee reported a credential-harvesting email impersonating the payroll provider. No credentials entered.
